messages.author: afb003e064114795
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] result - inla - temporal effect
parts:
In the table you show, the estimates are not close to zero; the credible intervals are not overlapping zero.

If they had been close to zero, the answer to your question would depend on the specifics of the modelling problem; there's no general answer.

Finn

Finn
